mapper.select: SELECT l.id AS id, l.shelf_id AS shelfId, s.shelf_no AS shelfNo, s.area AS area, l.location_no AS locationNo, l.row_no AS rowNo, l.column_no AS columnNo, l.capacity AS capacity, l.used_count AS usedCount, l.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(l.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(l.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM shelf_location l JOIN shelf s ON s.id = l.shelf_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE l.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM shelf_location WHERE shelf_id = #{shelfId} AND used_count > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shelf_location ( shelf_id, location_no, row_no, column_no, capacity, used_count, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{shelfId}, #{locationNo}, #{rowNo}, #{columnNo}, #{capacity}, #{usedCount}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE shelf_location SET location_no = #{locationNo}, row_no = #{rowNo}, column_no = #{columnNo}, capacity = #{capacity}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT l.id AS id, l.shelf_id AS shelfId, s.shelf_no AS shelfNo, s.area AS area, l.location_no AS locationNo, l.row_no AS rowNo, l.column_no AS columnNo, l.capacity AS capacity, l.used_count AS usedCount, l.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(l.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(l.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM shelf_location l JOIN shelf s ON s.id = l.shelf_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE l.status != 4 AND l.used_count < l.capacity AND s.status = 1 ORDER BY l.shelf_id ASC, l.row_no ASC, l.column_no ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE shelf_location SET used_count = used_count + 1, status = CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 4 WHEN used_count >= capacity THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND used_count < capacity
UPDATE shelf_location SET used_count = used_count - 1, status = CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 4 WHEN used_count <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND used_count > 0
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(l.capacity), 0) AS total, IFNULL(SUM(l.used_count), 0) AS used FROM shelf_location l JOIN shelf s ON s.id = l.shelf_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE s.status = 1 AND l.status != 4
